title: VPC offline usage collector and delayed sync for private deployments
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build an on-prem/VPC usage collector that works in air-gapped and delayed-sync environments to ensure correct billing, quota enforcement, and auditability. The collector should: 1) locally record per-request usage events (tokens, embeddings, model id, route) with immutable sequence ids; 2) produce verifiable, compressed exports for offline reconciliation; 3) support a secure push/pull sync when network is available; 4) provide checkpoints and deduplication so delayed deliveries do not double-bill; 5) surface local quota breaches to the tenant's control plane and to the operator console (when connected). This ticket covers design, PoC, and end-to-end validation for the export format and reconciliation tooling.
acceptance_criteria: Collector persists usage events with sequence numbers and local watermark checkpointing
Exports are produced in ndjson.gz with per-file manifest and signed hash for offline transfer
Reconciliation job can consume delayed exports and reconcile against cloud billing without double-counting
On-device quota enforcement prevents overage locally with transparent reporting to ops console when connected
End-to-end tests simulate 0%, 50%, 100% packet loss and validate eventual correctness of accounting
implementation_plan: Design export schema (schema v1) with fields: timestamp, seq_id, request_id, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, route, customer_id, signature
Build lightweight collector service (Go) that writes to WAL and rotates daily compressed exports
Add local dedupe using seq_id + request_id and idempotency markers; maintain low-memory index for recent seq windows
Implement manifest signing using customer-managed KMS/HSM where available; fallback to local key with rotation
Create reconciliation consumer that accepts ndjson.gz exports, verifies manifest signatures, and merges into billing pipeline with idempotent upsert
Integrate with existing rate-limiter to allow configurable local quota policy and staged enforcement (warn -> hard-limit)
Add observability: local metrics endpoint, export health dashboard, and debug CLI to produce sample exports
Run tabletop incident simulation and record runbook for common failure modes (stale exports, clock drift, partial uploads)

attachments: design: Private telemetry export schema v1 (PDF)
notes: Trade-offs considered: push vs pull model. Push simplifies reconciliation (collector initiates upload) but is harder in air-gapped installs. Chosen approach: support both but make uploads resumable and verify manifest signatures to prevent tampering.

Quota enforcement options: soft-percent thresholds with local tokens stored + hard cap. For strict compliance customers we will enable hard-local-enforcement with operator overrides recorded in audit logs.

Billing correctness: reconciliation will use (customer_id, request_id) upsert semantics with per-export monotonic seq_id to avoid double counting. We will add a reconciliation delta audit that emits any adjustments for transparency.
Operational concerns: disk limits, retention policy, and export rotation must be configurable. Provide auto-prune for exports older than retention window and backpressure signals when disk > 80%.

Privacy/compliance: exports will contain only necessary billing fields and omit free-text prompts by default. Customers requiring full request storage must opt in and sign TOU; security review required.
